premise: Crab tries to walk straight ahead to visit Starfish and tips over; Hermit Crab tells him crab legs bend sideways, and off he zips.
inspiration: Kipling's 'Just So' how-the-animal-got-its-ways tale, turned true: the reason is how crab legs are made, and the tumble is the funny part.
lesson: The way you are made is the way that works for you.
learning: Crabs walk sideways because their legs bend sideways.

en-US.title: Why Crab Walks Sideways
en-US.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Crab sat up on the rocks. Down in the pool stood {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish, on two of her five orange arms. She {starfish:live} waved hello. {crab:face happy} Crab wanted to go and see her the way everybody does: straight ahead. [playfully] One step forward. {crab:wobble} Wobble! Two steps forward. {crab:spin} Oops! His legs got all in a tangle, and over he went, upside down. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} Along came {hermit-crab:enter} Hermit Crab, carrying his striped shell. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] Why are you walking frontwards? he asked. Crab legs bend sideways. That's the way they're made! {crab:face happy} So Crab tried it. {sfx:click} Click, click, sideways… {crab:go to starfish} zip! He was there in a moment. {starfish:hop x2} {crab:live} Crab clicked his claws and did a happy sideways dance. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] And crabs have gone sideways ever since.

es-ES.title: Por qué Cangrejo va de lado
es-ES.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Cangrejo estaba sentado en las rocas. Abajo, en la charca, estaba {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella, sobre dos de sus cinco brazos naranjas. Ella {starfish:live} lo saludó. {crab:face happy} Cangrejo quería ir a verla como todo el mundo: hacia delante. [playfully] Un paso adelante. {crab:wobble} ¡Tambaleo! Dos pasos adelante. {crab:spin} ¡Huy! Se le enredaron las patas y se dio la vuelta, boca arriba. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} Entonces llegó {hermit-crab:enter} Cangrejo Ermitaño, con su concha de rayas a cuestas. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] ¿Por qué andas hacia delante?, preguntó. Las patas de los cangrejos se doblan de lado. ¡Están hechas así! {crab:face happy} Así que Cangrejo lo probó. {sfx:click} Clic, clic, de lado… {crab:go to starfish} ¡zas! Llegó en un momento. {starfish:hop x2} {crab:live} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó de lado, muy contento. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] Y desde entonces, los cangrejos van de lado.
